discriminators.COMPLETE_FIRST_LEVEL: Complete the missing first-level result before interpretation.
discriminators.RIPA: Distinguish enhanced platelet-dependent binding (type 2B or platelet-type VWD).
discriminators.VWF_MULTIMER: Distinguish loss of high-molecular-weight multimers from quantitative deficiency.
discriminators.VWF_CB: Provide a functional binding readout that can expose a qualitative VWF defect.
discriminators.VWF_FVIIIB: Assess FVIII-binding capacity when type 2N is plausible.
discriminators.VWF_PP: Distinguish secretion defects from clearance phenotypes.
discriminators.DDAVP_0_1_4H: Characterize the diagnostic response at 0, 1, and 4 hours; V0 does not provide treatment advice.
discriminators.WAIT_SECOND_LEVEL_RESULTS: Wait for real second-level observations; do not synthesize or impute results.
discriminators.WAIT_GENETICS: Hold the provisional pre-genetic assessment until the genetic report is available.
discriminators.EXPERT_REVIEW: Escalate incomplete, conflicting, or out-of-scope evidence to a VWD expert.
